name: matilyn.moe
desc: This site. A 2000s-portal layout built with Vue components and utility CSS, generated to static HTML.
details: Personal site built in Nuxt and Vue so the layout could be split into reusable components like the titled box used throughout.
Styled with UnoCSS utility classes. The retro palette, fonts and repeated patterns (boxes, tables, dotted lists) live in one config file as theme colors and shortcuts.
Text sizes are in em off a single body size, so the whole site's type can be resized from one place. The layout is three columns at 1024px and up, two on tablets, and one on phones.
Steam and AniList activity is fetched once at build time and baked into the pages, so the static site never calls those APIs or exposes the Steam key.
Projects, updates and links are JSON data files, so adding an entry updates every page that shows it.

name: SaGa Frontier CRT setup
desc: SaGa Frontier Remastered at an integer-scaled 480p with a CRT shader on top, and working controller input.
details: Nested gamescope on Wayland breaks controller input. It only works with the SDL backend using "SDL_VIDEODRIVER=x11"
vkBasalt hooks gamescope's own output, not the game, so the CRT shader runs on the upscaled 1440p frame while the game renders at 852×480 with nearest-neighbour integer scaling.
The CRT-Lottes shader (from RSRetroArch) is edited for the emulated resolution, with the screen curvature turned off and a texture-coordinate fix.
Launch: `ENABLE_VKBASALT=1 SDL_VIDEODRIVER=x11 gamescope --backend sdl -w 852 -h 480 -W 2560 -H 1440 -S integer -F nearest -f -- env ENABLE_VKBASALT=0 %command%`

name: First Person Mech
desc: A first-person mech game: take contracts from a garage hub, fit weapons, and fight with lock-on combat.
details: WIP: a player controller with a weapon manager and lock-on, hitbox/hurtbox combat, and enemies driven by their own AI script.
Weapons, attacks and contracts are data resources, so new ones are data files rather than new code.

name: PrusaSlicer miniature tuning
tech: PrusaSlicer 2.9 (Flatpak), Prusa MK4IS, 0.25mm nozzle, Prusament PLA
desc: Print and filament presets for tabletop miniatures on a 0.25mm nozzle.
details: Two 0.25 nozzle print presets: 0.07mm DETAIL for everyday printing and 0.0625mm ULTRADETAIL.
Supports are paint-on only by default. Minis that arrive tilted 45° and floating get "Everywhere" supports per project instead.
